description: BDREP - Liste des établissements is published by ADEME. BDREP identifies facilities reporting pollutant emissions and waste through GEREP. Its stated coverage is France; reporting industrial establishments. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. The release lists establishments, not every emission observation in the wider register. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
